method: Dynamic theme priority is based on two separate questions: WHAT'S NEW (fresh material evidence/catalyst/price confirmation) and WHAT MATTERS MOST NOW (current cross-asset, sector, earnings, inflation/rates and portfolio transmission). Historical importance alone does not keep a theme near the top.

whatsNewNow: August ISM Services reaccelerated to 55.4 with Business Activity 61.7 and New Orders 60.9, while Prices rose to 72.6 and Employment remained contractionary at 47.8.

Official ISM-selected respondent evidence explicitly says large transmission and generation investment is driving material purchasing and planning for long-lead items, strengthening the Power/Grid thesis.
US diesel retail and diesel cracks reached records, keeping refined products as the strongest immediate inflation channel.
Waller lowered near-term hike expectations and yields eased, triggering a broad precious-metals rebound and tactical equity risk-on without removing structural long-rate pressure.
Snowflake raised product-revenue guidance and attributed roughly half of recent acceleration to AI, strengthening selective software monetisation.
Black Sea wheat disruption is rerouting Asian imports toward higher-cost Australian/Argentine supply, raising food/logistics inflation.
Dominion shareholder approval of the NextEra merger makes data-centre load cost allocation and regulated-utility consolidation a live research mechanism.
whatMattersMostNow: Services demand reacceleration with hot prices and weak hiring
Transmission/generation and AI physical long-lead capex
Structurally restrictive real/long yields despite tactical policy relief
Funded-load quality and utility ratepayer politics

newThemes.name: Services Reacceleration + Hot Prices / Weak Hiring
newThemes.summary: US services demand reaccelerated sharply while prices heated up and employment stayed in contraction, creating a stagflationary rather than clean risk-on signal.
newThemes.whyNow: August ISM Services PMI rose to 55.4, Business Activity to 61.7, New Orders to 60.9 and Prices to 72.6, while Employment remained 47.8.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Supports current demand and physical capex but keeps the Fed/inflation hurdle alive, particularly for long-duration and financed discretionary equities.
newThemes.confirmation: Strong activity/orders persist without disinflation or labour improvement.
newThemes.invalidation: Services demand rolls over quickly while prices cool and yields fall sustainably.
newThemes.nextTest: Sep 4 NFP, Sep 10 PPI and Sep 11 CPI.
newThemes.watchlistAction: Prefer current cash flow, pricing power and booked physical demand over speculative duration.

newThemes.name: Gold / Silver / Precious-Metal Reconfirmation
newThemes.summary: Precious metals regained tactical confirmation as Waller reduced hike expectations and yields/dollar eased, while geopolitical/fiscal hedge demand remained intact.
newThemes.whyNow: Gold rose 2.3%, silver 2.8%, platinum 4.2% and palladium 5.9% on Sep 3.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Improves the entry setup for gold/streamers/miners, but the move remains vulnerable to NFP/CPI and a renewed real-yield breakout.
newThemes.confirmation: Bullion holds gains while real yields stop rising.
newThemes.invalidation: Hot macro data drives a renewed real-yield/USD breakout and bullion loses support.
newThemes.watchlistAction: Move from wait-for-stabilisation to staged exposure; do not chase a single-session spike.

newThemes.name: Food / Grain Rerouting + Farm Affordability
newThemes.summary: Black Sea logistics disruption is lifting delivered grain costs for Asian importers while farm-input demand remains differentiated by elasticity.
newThemes.whyNow: Asian buyers are switching meaningful wheat volumes toward Australia and Argentina at higher delivered prices; CBOT wheat is up roughly 35% since late June.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Raises food-import inflation and can improve crop economics, but fertilizer/machinery demand still depends on crop-input ratios and farm margins.
newThemes.confirmation: Export disruptions persist and crop economics improve enough to support inputs.
newThemes.invalidation: Black Sea logistics normalize and crop prices fall before farm margins recover.
newThemes.nextTest: Export flows, crop forecasts and fertilizer/machinery orders.
newThemes.watchlistAction: BG/CTVA/CF remain higher-quality expressions; AGCO stays second-stage cyclical recovery.

newThemes.name: Utility Consolidation + Data-Centre Load Cost Allocation
newThemes.summary: AI load growth is becoming a regulated-utility consolidation and ratepayer-allocation issue, not just an equipment-demand story.
newThemes.whyNow: Dominion shareholders approved the $66.8B NextEra merger; regulators are focusing on affordability, market dominance and who pays for data-centre infrastructure.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Utility scale can lower financing/procurement costs, but adverse cost allocation or regulatory conditions can delay projects and cap returns.
newThemes.confirmation: Regulators permit attractive investment economics while shielding ordinary ratepayers.
newThemes.invalidation: Deal failure or punitive cost-allocation rules materially reduce returns.
newThemes.nextTest: State/FERC/NRC merger review and Virginia load-cost rules.
newThemes.watchlistAction: Research only; no NEE/D promotion until regulatory economics are clear.

refining-product-inflation.whyNow: US diesel retail reached a record $5.820/gal and the diesel crack reached a record $108.02/bbl with inventories historically low.
refining-product-inflation.marketTransmission: Freight, agriculture, industrial and consumer costs rise; refiners/integrated energy benefit until demand destruction dominates.
refining-product-inflation.confirmation: Diesel cracks and low distillate inventories persist despite high refinery utilisation.
refining-product-inflation.nextTest: EIA distillates, refinery outages and Hormuz/Russia flows.
refining-product-inflation.watchlistAction: Prefer XOM and quality refiners; do not chase pure upstream beta.

ai-physical-bottlenecks.whyNow: Official ISM Services respondent evidence explicitly ties large transmission/generation investment to material purchasing and long-lead planning.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.marketTransmission: Supports transmission, switchgear, power management, generation and time-to-power suppliers even while speculative requested MW are screened.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.confirmation: Backlog/customer funding/cash conversion continue to rise.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.invalidation: Supplier backlog deteriorates or funded-load cancellations spread.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.watchlistAction: Keep PWR/ETN/GEV/VRT high quality, but maintain entry discipline.

long-end-duration-stress.whyNow: Waller's dovish signal lowered the 10Y toward 4.77%, but mortgage rates near 6.71%, fiscal deficits and AI capital demand keep structural neutral/long rates high.
long-end-duration-stress.marketTransmission: Long-duration, leveraged and pre-commercial assets retain a high discount-rate/funding hurdle.
long-end-duration-stress.confirmation: Real/long yields remain elevated even as policy expectations fluctuate.
long-end-duration-stress.invalidation: Durable real-yield collapse with disinflation and fiscal-term-premium relief.
long-end-duration-stress.watchlistAction: Separate structural quality from buy-now valuation.

software-relative-strength.whyNow: Snowflake raised FY27 product-revenue guidance to $6.07B and said AI contributed roughly half of recent acceleration.
software-relative-strength.marketTransmission: Validates selective enterprise-AI consumption and supports quality software relative to generic SaaS beta.
software-relative-strength.confirmation: RPO/ARR/product revenue/FCF improve across multiple vendors.
software-relative-strength.invalidation: AI uptake fails to translate to consumption/cash conversion.
software-relative-strength.watchlistAction: Use pullbacks; do not chase SNOW's earnings gap.

fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.whyNow: Nitrogen scarcity remains constructive, but CF is crowded and grain/input affordability now matters more than the headline fertilizer price.
fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.marketTransmission: North American nitrogen producers retain feedstock advantage; potash/phosphate and machinery are more deferrable.
fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.confirmation: Nitrogen pricing remains firm without major application destruction.
fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.invalidation: Rapid Gulf normalization or farm-margin collapse cuts application.
fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.watchlistAction: CF quality intact but no chase; CTVA/BG offer differentiated agriculture exposure.

energy-security-americas-lng.whyNow: Diversification away from Gulf concentration remains structural, but no equally large fresh catalyst outranks current diesel/services/AI-power developments.
energy-security-americas-lng.marketTransmission: Supports contracted US LNG, pipelines and Americas crude logistics.
energy-security-americas-lng.confirmation: Long-term contracting/export flows remain elevated after spot-war volatility.
energy-security-americas-lng.invalidation: Rapid normalization plus LNG oversupply weakens contracts/spreads.

ai-financing-cash-conversion.whyNow: Funding quality remains a gating variable, but fresh evidence this cycle is stronger in hard orders/capex and service inflation than in new financing distress.
ai-financing-cash-conversion.marketTransmission: Customer funding and FCF discriminate winners from speculative developers.
ai-financing-cash-conversion.nextTest: Capex-to-revenue, convertibles, utilisation and customer prepayments.

copper-scarcity-squeeze-risk.whyNow: Grid/electrification demand remains supportive but no fresh copper-specific shock outranks current themes.
copper-scarcity-squeeze-risk.nextTest: LME/COMEX stocks, mine disruptions, China demand.
copper-scarcity-squeeze-risk.watchlistAction: FCX near $70-72 remains the preferred quality entry expression.

water-food-energy-collision.watchlistAction: VMI/XYL/ECL remain differentiated crossovers; no fresh promotion.

rubber-acreage-squeeze.watchlistAction: Background only until fresh price/earnings transmission appears.

personalized-oncology.watchlistAction: Outside current Power Stack market-significance hierarchy.
